test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Seven boys Laxman, Mohan, Bit, Sohil. Rahul, Ram and Ramesh are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Sohil is third to the left of Bittu. Mohan is second to the right of Bittu. Ram is third to the right of Ramesh. Ramesh is not the immediate neighbour of Mohan. Laxman is third to the left of Rahul.

Who is to the immediate left of Ram?
solution:
**Given :** Seven boys Laxman, Mohan, Bit, Sohil. Rahul, Ram and Ramesh are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

**Explanation : **

1) Sohil is third to the left of Bittu.

2) Mohan is second to the right of Bittu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49339698f31c215da90edb1691c0dde3d671957af41ade321af7d97894b34397.png] 

3) Ramesh is not the immediate neighbour of Mohan.

4) Ram is third to the right of Ramesh. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cac8fc80e63f9c1ac837f3cd8a2bc54cd8be053f42c5e13442d22af788219ce.png] 

5) Laxman is third to the left of Rahul.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/753c812b568d195790c46806b7748bb084561db45a7f887a6a8da3375c1e70d0.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Bittu is to the immediate left of Ram.

Hence, "**Bittu**" is the correct answer.
